entries.summary: A struct that allocates nothing and runs the action with its state on every dispose of every copy.
Holds one resource you can replace; replacing it does not dispose the old one.
Holds one resource and disposes it when another replaces it.
Takes one resource, once; a second assignment throws `InvalidOperationException`.

entries.summary: Disposes the value when the scope ends unless `Release()` hands it on first.

Records only that it was disposed, in `IsDisposed`.
